findings: No further tg gain found across all 3 avenues; 0.86 t/s (2.26x) stands as the practical ceiling.
Build (GGML_LTO=ON): 0.86, no gain - the -O3 hot vec_dot loop is already optimal, cross-module inlining does not help.
Config (KV q8_0, flash-attn on): 0.85-0.86, no gain - these knobs do not affect short-context token generation.

Op-reduction (avenue 2): re-profile shows vec_dot 81%, ~13% threadpool-barrier spin is the ONLY remaining headroom. Capturing it needs invasive ggml op-fusion (fold sign-flip ggml_mul into the FWHT across ~300 sites/token), high whole-model correctness risk, ~4-5% realistic payoff. Researched, not pursued - risk/reward unfavorable on an already-2.26x kernel.
